title: Parts Program Uplift on KestrelCare Repair Payments
content:
| Vehicle program on the covered vehicle's purchase order | Parts uplift on a KestrelCare repair payment |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Premium Certified, Kestrel Factory Certified | 10 percent (the premium parts uplift) |
| Kestrel Certified, Kestrel Certified Plus | 5 percent (the certified parts uplift) |
| any other program | none |

**Rule.** A parts-program uplift is added to a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts repair payment for the parts the vehicle program requires, read from the covered vehicle's Vehicle Purchase Agreements purchase order: a vehicle sold as Kestrel Premium Certified or Kestrel Factory Certified adds the premium parts uplift, a vehicle sold as Kestrel Certified or Kestrel Certified Plus adds the certified parts uplift, and any other program adds none.

The uplift is added by multiplying the amount by one plus the uplift, before the payment is compared with the coverage remaining.

*Hypothetical:* an amount of 2000.00 becomes 2200.00 on a Kestrel Premium Certified vehicle, 2100.00 on a Kestrel Certified vehicle and stays 2000.00 on a Kestrel Inspected vehicle.
